summary: Iteration 6 AI-provider modularization refactor. Full backend regression PASSES: 58/58 tests green (49 pre-existing + 9 new refactor-invariant tests). All endpoint contracts unchanged; response shapes and content identical to iter5. Verified server.py no longer imports emergentintegrations directly, get_ai_service() is a singleton (id() matches across calls & re-imports), compute_bmi/compute_calorie_goal remain in server.py, and RECOVERY_STATUS_LABELS (now in ai/constants.py) have identical values/order in all 8 languages.

minor.issue: test_analyze_food_lang[fr] still occasionally flaky (~10% - Gemini non-determinism from iter5); passed on this run.

action_items: None. Refactor is transparent; all endpoint contracts preserved.
Optional (non-blocking, carried over): migrate FastAPI on_event('shutdown') to lifespan handler.
critical_code_review_comments: ai/__init__.py cleanly separates provider selection via AI_PROVIDER env; adding a new backend is a 2-step registration (good).
ai/base.py AIProvider ABC + extract_json helper is a solid seam; concrete SDK imports are confined to ai/gemini_provider.py.
ai/service.py owns all prompts + default field seeding, so provider swap is truly transparent to endpoints.
server.py trimmed from 1138 -> 565 lines; endpoints only touch DB + Pydantic + AIService methods. Good separation.
get_ai_service() uses @lru_cache(maxsize=1) - correct singleton semantics; verified id() matches across imports.
Recovery status computation (score + label) stays algorithmic in server.py; only the free-text advice is delegated to the LLM - preserves iter5 behavior exactly.
GeminiProvider retries once on transient failure (max_retries=1 default) and wraps errors in AIProviderError - endpoints then re-raise as HTTP 500 via _ai_error(). Consistent error contract.
seed_data_creation: Re-downloaded /tmp/food.jpg, /tmp/pantry.jpg, /tmp/img1-3.jpg (missing in this env). Real photos required by AI-dependent tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI subsystem lives under /app/backend/ai/. To add a new provider register it in ai/__init__.py._build_provider. Endpoints must never import SDKs directly. Test images at /tmp/*.jpg are required by AI tests; the pantry.jpg URL used previously (unsplash 1584473457409-ce95a9c00c86) returned 29 bytes - use the pexels URL instead (photo 4033148). analyze_food[fr] remains ~10% flaky due to LLM non-determinism.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a - clean regression pass on the refactor.
